method: Company store counts grouped by EIA/PADD region and normalized across the three configured market regions
notes: These are store-count exposure weights, not gallon-exposure weights.
Colorado (51 stores), Utah (5), and Nevada (4) are excluded because the configured model has no Rocky Mountain or West Coast series.
The 60 excluded stores are 3.3% of the reported 1,800-store network.
Replace these weights if company-reported or defensibly estimated regional gallon exposure becomes available.
source: Murphy USA Inc. 2025 Form 10-K, Item 1 store-count table
